type.name: Status
type.doc: Defines common return status codes. Compare against {::Ok} for success.

value.name: Ok
value.doc: Operation succeded.

value.name: Timeout
value.doc: Operation timed out.

value.name: Partial
value.doc: Operation partially succeeded.

value.name: InvalidArgument
value.doc: One or more arguments, or parts of arguments passed to the function were incorrect.

value.name: OutOfHostMemory
value.doc: There is no more host memory available.

value.name: OutOfDeviceMemory
value.doc: There is no more device memory available.

value.name: DeviceLost
value.doc: Device driver was forcefully stopped.

value.name: Occluded
value.doc: Swapchain presentation was not visible to the user. Rendering is too fast.

value.name: ValidationFailed
value.doc: A validation layer found an error.

value.name: Error
value.doc: Operation failed.

type.name: AdapterPreference
type.doc: Orders the adapters according to preference using builtin heuristics of underlying APIs. For DirectX 12, this translates directly to `DXGI_GPU_PREFERENCE`. For Vulkan, sorting is based on `VkPhysicalDeviceType` heuristics.

value.name: None
value.doc: No particular preference, list adapters in system devised order.

value.name: MinConsumption
value.doc: List the adapters from low power consumption to high. DirectX 12: Integrated, Discrete, External, Software. Vulkan: Integrated GPU, Discrete GPU, Virtual GPU, CPU.

value.name: Performance
value.doc: List the adapters from high performance to low. DirectX 12: External, Discrete, Integrated, Software. Vulkan: Discrete GPU, Integrated GPU, Virtual GPU, CPU.

type.name: Severity
type.doc: Defines severity levels for logging and debugging messages.

value.name: Verbose
value.doc: Verbose level messages, typically used for detailed debugging information.

value.name: Info
value.doc: Informational messages that highlight the progress of the application.

value.name: Warning
value.doc: Potentially harmful situations that warrant attention but do not prevent normal operation.

value.name: Error
value.doc: Error events that might still allow the application to continue running.

value.name: Fatal
value.doc: Severe error events that will presumably lead the application to abort.

type.name: CommandQueueType
type.doc: Defines types of command queues that can be created on the device. Each type corresponds to a specific kind of workload that the GPU can handle.

value.name: Graphics
value.doc: Command queue for graphics operations, including rendering and compute tasks.

value.name: Compute
value.doc: Command queue dedicated to compute operations, optimized for parallel processing tasks.

value.name: Transfer
value.doc: Command queue for data transfer operations, such as copying resources between buffers and images.

value.name: VideoDecode
value.doc: Command queue for video decoding operations.

value.name: VideoEncode
value.doc: Command queue for video encoding operations.

value.name: Count
value.doc: Number of command queue types available.

value.name: None
value.doc: No flags set. Adapter may be descrete or embedded.

value.name: Remote
value.doc: Adapter is remote. Used for remote rendering.

value.name: Software
value.doc: Adapter is software. Uses CPU for software rendering.
